comment: Shared verdict-key vector for the NVD window and baseline checkpoint verdicts a satellite stamps on the vulnerability.source_snapshot payload and the Eshu core extension host reads (eshu-hq/eshu-sdk#93, eshu-hq/eshu#10732). Reader: eshu go/internal/collector/extensionhost nvd_window_cursor.go (armNVDWindowCursorWriter) and nvd_baseline_cursor.go (NVDBaselineCommitPolicy.CommitPolicy), read at eshu origin/main f6c9b68d4d5d9b4ef39b5490b1109cc7f1e4b1c2 and replayed unchanged at 6bf9450d7acb. Writers: eshu-collector-vulnerability-intelligence origin/main ffbeade7d38374d0bec8d2c4e6f327d7bd6f99ac for the window keys (stampNVDWindowVerdict, decideNVDWindowAdvance) and, for the baseline keys, its unmerged branch drive/158-nvd-baseline-snapshot-keys at 6965a17 (nvdBaselineSnapshot), because collector main does not yet stamp them. Numbers are plain JSON numbers because the claim transport decodes them as float64. expect.advance_to, expect.head and expect.year_complete are what the armed commit-transaction writer carries, and 0, 0 and false when no writer is armed. A case's malformed_keys names payload keys that deliberately carry the wrong JSON type. emitted_by_collector is true only when a real collector builder can stamp exactly that payload; false marks a reader pin that exercises core on input the collector never emits. Payload keys that ride on the same snapshot but are outside this vector: nvd_keyed, nvd_transport, nvd_feed_selector, nvd_feed_time_unix_us, nvd_feed_span_start_unix_us, nvd_feed_sha256.

keys.name: nvd_window_advance_to_unix_us
keys.note: The next cursor. 0 when should_advance is false. Core arms nothing when it is not positive.

keys.name: nvd_window_head_unix_us
keys.note: The server catalog head the advance was clamped to. 0 when unknown.

keys.name: nvd_window_should_advance
keys.note: Strict: only the JSON boolean true can move the cursor. The string "true" holds.

keys.name: nvd_window_time_anomaly_reason
keys.note: Pinned, not read by core: a hold rides on should_advance false. Empty when the observation is clean.

keys.name: nvd_window_pages_refetched
keys.note: Informational, not read by core, not cased: window pages refetched after a retryable failure.

keys.name: nvd_window_pages_downsized
keys.note: Informational, not read by core, not cased: window pages refetched at a halved size after an oversize page.

keys.name: nvd_window_split
keys.note: Informational, not read by core, not cased: stamped true on a claim that was split across the feed or the API.

keys.name: nvd_window_retry_reason
keys.note: Informational, not read by core, not cased: present only when the window refetched from its minted start.

cases.name: advances
cases.note: A clean window: should_advance true, a positive advance_to, the server head. The writer is armed with both.

cases.name: advances_clamped_to_head
cases.note: The collector clamps advance_to to min(planned end, head), so a head before the window end is the advance.

cases.name: advances_with_record_beyond_head_anomaly
cases.note: A time anomaly alone never holds the cursor: the reader does not read time_anomaly_reason.

cases.name: holds_head_unknown
cases.note: No server head, so the collector stamps should_advance false with advance_to and head 0. Facts commit, the cursor holds.

cases.name: holds_head_behind_cursor
cases.note: The server head reads at or before the window start: the collector holds rather than moving the cursor backward.

cases.name: holds_should_advance_false
cases.note: Reader pin, not a shape the collector emits: should_advance false holds even beside a positive advance_to.

cases.name: holds_zero_advance_to
cases.note: Reader pin, not a shape the collector emits: should_advance true with advance_to 0 is degenerate and arms nothing.

cases.name: holds_string_should_advance
cases.note: The verdict is strict: the string "true" is not the boolean true, so the cursor holds.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_run
keys.note: Informational, not read by core: the run id is parsed from the scope id.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_year
keys.note: Informational, not read by core: the year is parsed from the scope id.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_advance_to_unix_us
keys.note: The resume stamp the next chunk starts from, exclusive. Core floors it to a whole millisecond.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_year_sha256
keys.note: The seed year file identity: 64 lowercase hex characters once surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Anything else covers nothing.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_year_complete
keys.note: True when the chunk finished the year. A complete chunk may land exactly on its start.

keys.name: nvd_baseline_should_advance
keys.note: Strict: only the JSON boolean true can advance the checkpoint.

cases.name: advances_past_start
cases.note: An incomplete chunk that moves strictly past its start: the checkpoint is armed to advance_to.

cases.name: advances_complete_past_start
cases.note: A year-complete chunk past its start.

cases.name: advances_complete_at_start
cases.note: A complete chunk may land exactly on its start: it resumed at the stream tail and has no later stamp to name.

cases.name: advances_sub_millisecond_floors
cases.note: advance_to is floored to a whole millisecond, never rounded up, so a stored resume can only re-read.

cases.name: not_covered_incomplete_at_start
cases.note: Reader pin, not a shape the collector emits (it stamps should_advance false here): an incomplete chunk that does not move past its start would re-mint the same scope forever.

cases.name: not_covered_sub_millisecond_floors_to_start
cases.note: The floor applies before the comparison, so a sub-millisecond lead over the start is no progress.

cases.name: not_covered_behind_start
cases.note: No verdict may move behind the chunk start.

cases.name: not_covered_complete_behind_start
cases.note: A complete verdict is also refused behind the start: the behind-start check comes first.

cases.name: not_covered_missing_advance
cases.note: should_advance true without an advance_to stamp.

cases.name: not_covered_zero_advance
cases.note: A non-positive advance_to is missing.

cases.name: not_covered_string_advance
cases.note: advance_to must be a JSON number; a string is missing.

cases.name: not_covered_sha_blank
cases.note: A blank seed sha names nothing the next plan can pin.

cases.name: not_covered_sha_malformed
cases.note: The seed sha is 64 lowercase hex characters; uppercase is malformed.

cases.name: advances_sha_with_surrounding_whitespace
cases.note: Core trims surrounding whitespace from the seed sha before the 64-hex check and stores the trimmed value, so padded input is accepted.

cases.name: holds_should_advance_false
cases.note: The no-progress shape: an incomplete chunk that resumed at its own start and found nothing past it. should_advance is false, so facts commit and the checkpoint holds.

cases.name: holds_string_should_advance
cases.note: The verdict is strict: the string "true" is not the boolean true.

cases.name: holds_no_snapshot_keys
cases.note: A snapshot that carries only identity keys has no verdict, so the checkpoint holds.

cases.name: refused_window_verdict_present
cases.note: A baseline generation carrying a window advance verdict is refused and nothing commits: a baseline chunk never arms the window cursor writer.

cases.name: refused_window_verdict_beside_baseline_hold
cases.note: The window-verdict refusal comes before the baseline should_advance check, so a baseline hold does not hide it.
